description:
Access Interior Company’s design platform directly within the chat. Browse latest design for every space— modular kitchens, wardrobes, living rooms, and bedrooms. Explore individual products, stay updated with trends and how-to guides, and discover interior designers by city.
Use the interactive full-home cost calculator to estimate your interior budget based on your layout configuration, and book a free design consultation in just three simple steps. All listings, prices, and results are fetched in real time from Interior Company’s —nothing is fabricated.

defaultPrompt: Estimate the cost to design my 3BHK
Show me modular kitchen design ideas
Book a meeting with an interior designer in Gurgaon
